Mobilis alerte ses abonnés : ne laissez: Mobilis alerts its subscribers: do not let anyone use your SIM card or personal number. The operator reminds users of essential practices to protect their security and privacy.
Alger, 19 avril 2026 – Dans une campagne: Algiers, April 19, 2026 – In an awareness campaign aimed at all its subscribers, Mobilis, the historic mobile telephony operator in Algeria, is warning against the risks associated with sharing or unauthorized use of the SIM card and personal number.
« Pour votre sécurité et celle de vos do: "For your security and that of your data, do not allow anyone to use your SIM card or personal number," the operator insists. In the event of loss or theft of the phone or SIM card, Mobilis recommends an immediate report in order to suspend the line.
Les abonnés peuvent effectuer cette déma: Subscribers can carry out this procedure by visiting one of the operator's commercial agencies or by contacting customer service directly. A simple but essential measure to prevent any fraudulent use and protect personal information.
Avec cet avertissement, Mobilis réaffirm: With this warning, Mobilis reaffirms its commitment to supporting its customers toward a safer and more responsible use of mobile services.
